findings.title: Stream close ordering could allow stream_close()/_stream_closing to run before sink…
findings.claim: Checked whether sink::close() properly sends the eof marker and waits for it before calling close_sink(), ensuring stream_close() and the new _stream_closing flag only run after all sink traffic is done; found this to be correctly ordered.

findings.title: Concurrent stop() during stream_close() could cause double write_buf.close() or race
findings.claim: Checked the case where stop() runs while stream_close() is waiting for the queue to drain; found it still waits on _sink_closed_future and correctly skips the second write_buf.close(), as before.

findings.title: Exceptional drained queue future might prevent write buffer from being closed
findings.claim: Checked that an exceptional drained queue future is ignored and the write buffer is still closed; found this handled correctly.

findings.title: Compressor's send_empty_frame hook now receives closed_error from send({}) during the…
findings.claim: The send_empty_frame hook now gets closed_error from send({}) during the window; this is stated to be the intended change, but the compressor implementation has to tolerate it.

findings.title: Test catches rpc::closed_error but never asserts it was actually thrown
findings.claim: A test catches rpc::closed_error but never asserts one was thrown, so it passes even if the send is accepted without a late put(); the report notes the separate put_after_close check does catch the actual regression, so this gap was not reported as a real issue.
